items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: The old man, he's Louis T.O. He was the oldest brother. Well, he studied in Mexico, you see?

ctx.x: We'd like to find him and talk to him. Maybe he would remember about his father and all of you.
Well, I could tell you about the father. If you could, let me wonder. The old man, he's Louis T.O. He was the oldest brother. Well, he studied in Mexico, you see?
Were they Mexicans or just studied?
